Name: OBJ_ACT_PARAM_ST
Description: Settings for characters interacting with objects

Fields.Name: Action Enabled - Message ID
Fields.Description: MsgID of the menu displayed when the action is enabled

Fields.Name: Action Failed - Message ID
Fields.Description: MsgID of the menu to display when the action fails

Fields.Name: Unconditional Qualified Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag for unconditionally passing special conditions

Fields.Name: Player Animation ID
Fields.Description: This is the animation ID of the player character during action

Fields.Name: Character Animation ID
Fields.Description: Anime ID for enemy actions etc.

Fields.Name: Valid Distance
Fields.Description: This is the effective distance of the action

Fields.Name: Object Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: This is the dummy poly ID that is the action position of the object

Fields.Name: Sync Event Trigger
Fields.Description: Should the events used in ObjAct execution judgment be synchronized? Basically set to ×. It may be set to ○ only if the actor is not important.

Fields.Name: Object Animation ID
Fields.Description: This is the animation ID when the object is in action

Fields.Name: Valid Player Angle
Fields.Description: The effective angle of the player's actions. Effective angular difference between the player's orientation vector and the object's orientation vector

Fields.Name: Valid Object Angle
Fields.Description: The effective angle of the object's action. Effective angle difference between object action vector and character vector

Fields.Name: Character Absorb Type
Fields.Description: This is how to attract characters during object action
